en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5049 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), it is reported that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"If it were appropriate for anyone to be stoned twice, it would be the one who commits sodomy (Al-Luti)."
